label: Cinematic Graphic Novel
styleLock: Mature painted graphic novel. Semi-realistic believable anatomy and architecture built from decisive brush-ink drawing; variable-width dark sepia-indigo contours with dry-brush breaks; restrained directional cross-hatching only in core shadows; four-to-six broad matte gouache-like color and value shapes with a few translucent glaze transitions; crisp focal edges with selectively lost or broken shadow edges; angular readable silhouette simplification; materials rendered through designed shape rhythms rather than photographic microtexture. High detail at faces, hands, eyes, creature heads, and key material junctions; medium detail across bodies and main buildings; sparse atmospheric backgrounds. Cinematic sequential-art finish, neither superhero comic nor photorealistic concept painting.
colorLock: Natural local colors with a deep ink-value structure, moderate saturation, warm-light/cool-shadow separation, and at most one restrained focal accent family appropriate to each subject. Do not force a shared palette or mood across subjects.

anchor.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Fantasy Crux house-style exploration anchor board
Primary request: Create one square 2x2 anchor board showing four separate fantasy subjects rendered by the same exact illustrator in one fully consistent new Cinematic Graphic Novel style.
Scene/backdrop: Top-left panel: an adult medieval woman warrior in a quiet village courtyard, alert but not fighting. Top-right panel: an adult brown bear in a forest clearing, standing naturally. Bottom-left panel: a four-legged, two-winged dragon on a rocky upland, standing in a readable three-quarter pose. Bottom-right panel: a small medieval village with timber-and-stone houses, a central well, and a watchtower.
Style/medium: Mature painted graphic novel. Semi-realistic believable anatomy and architecture built from decisive brush-ink drawing; variable-width dark sepia-indigo contours with dry-brush breaks; restrained directional cross-hatching only in core shadows; four-to-six broad matte gouache-like color and value shapes with a few translucent glaze transitions; crisp focal edges with selectively lost or broken shadow edges; angular readable silhouette simplification; materials rendered through designed shape rhythms rather than photographic microtexture. High detail at faces, hands, eyes, creature heads, and key material junctions; medium detail across bodies and main buildings; sparse atmospheric backgrounds. Cinematic sequential-art finish, neither superhero comic nor photorealistic concept painting.
Composition/framing: Square canvas divided into four equal panels with narrow clean gutters and no labels. Each subject and all essential anatomy must be complete, comfortably inside its panel, and safely framed. Each panel has one clear focal subject; the village panel is environment-only.
Lighting/mood: Neutral directional daylight with readable form and modest cinematic contrast; calm, grounded adventure tone. Do not make every panel gloomy or dramatic.
Color palette: Natural local colors with a deep ink-value structure, moderate saturation, warm-light/cool-shadow separation, and one restrained accent family appropriate to each individual subject. Do not force a shared palette or mood across panels.
Constraints: The same exact artist, brushwork, line-weight logic, hatching density, edge hierarchy, shape simplification, detail density, color construction, and material rendering in all four panels. Adult woman warrior. Bear has anatomically correct four limbs and plausible paws. Dragon has exactly four legs and exactly two wings. Village contains no focal people or creatures. No fire, magic, dramatic sky, rim light, speech balloons, captions, sound effects, halftone screen, panel labels, logo, watermark, decorative frame, enclosing heavy comic panel borders, extra focal subjects, glossy digital rendering, cel shading, anime styling, or photorealism.

qa.notes: All four panels share variable brush-ink, restrained shadow hatching, matte grouped color, compatible edge hierarchy, and the same focal-to-background detail falloff. Anatomy and required landmarks pass.
